newsitem.title: USA: DH Tech to merge with Axiohm of France.
newsitem.headline: DH Tech to merge with Axiohm of France.

text.p: DH Technology Inc and Axiohm SA, a private French company, said Tuesday they would merge, with Axiohm buying between 6.5 and 7.0 million DH shares at $25 each.
Axiohm, through a wholly owned unit, will commence a cash tender offer for the DH shares no later than July 21, the companies said.
As a result of a subsequent merger and related transactions, current DH shareholders will own 15 to 21 percent DH's outstanding shares, depending on the number of shares tendered, the companies said.
DH makes transaction printers and printing mechanisms, including magnetic and chip card readers and impact printheads.
